items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I knew him since I was there. I never knew him to have a job.

ctx.x: Who was that, Frankie? Yeah. No, I never knew Frankie Deucin. He never did a barber. He never did a barber.
He never did a barber. I knew him since I was there. I never knew him to have a job.
I believe Fess told me he was a good ball player. Do you remember? Did he play baseball much?
